limits: Callers traced up to 2 hops; deeper callers are not shown.

Impact is static parser analysis: calls through variables, dynamic dispatch or class hierarchies may be missed. Unresolved references that could reach a changed symbol are listed as unknowns, not as safe.
Language 'typescript' is supported at tier 'static_probe': static cross-file impact plus a probe harness; no end-to-end behavior run is verified for this language yet. Treat missing paths as unknown.
'same_on_tested_cases' means identical output for these frozen inputs only; it is not proof of equivalence.
